The purchase consideration of $45 million...","source_id":"ch_cdca9b379a363798"}],"confidence":0.95,"answer":"In FY2023, Amcor completed three major acquisitions within its Flexibles reportable segment:
1. On August 1, 2022, 100% equity interest in a Czech Republic company operating a flexible packaging manufacturing plant, with a purchase consideration of $59 million.
2. On March 17, 2023, 100% equity interest in a medical device packaging manufacturing site in Shanghai, China, with a purchase consideration of $60 million.
3. On May 31, 2023, a New Zealand-based manufacturer of automated protein packaging machines, with a purchase consideration of $45 million.

For FY2022 and FY2021, Amcor's Note 5 ("Acquisitions and Divestitures") does not report any major business acquisitions completed during those fiscal years, focusing instead on disposals, restructuring, and portfolio optimization under the Bemis Integration Plan.","rationale":"The answer details the acquisitions listed in Note 5 of the FY2023 10-K, meeting all length requirements for citations."}
